Israeli election: PM loses a significant number of seats since 2022 election

Israel was counting votes on Wednesday after pivotal elections in which exit polls showed no clear winner. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc appears to have lost a significant number of seats compared with the previous election in 2022. France 24's International Affairs Editor Angela Diffley shares further insights.
